Picture a value as a block of memory with a fixed width. Every field of a struct, and every payload of an enum variant, sits inside that block, laid out one after another.

So the width of `Node(Tree, Tree)` would have to be: width of `Tree`, plus width of `Tree`, plus a tag to say which variant it is. That is strictly bigger than the width of `Tree`. No number satisfies it, so the compiler gives up: E0072.
